hook.name: KlikHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook for klik.finance that charges market-cap-tiered fees (0.10%–1.00%) on token swaps, split between a platform treasury and the token creator. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims to support single-sided launch pools and flushed on subsequent swaps. Includes launch-block locking and per-origin anti-snipe buy caps in USD for the first few blocks after pool deployment.
